title: Community Interpretation
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Community Interpretation - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - MAS557/C/MCE557
outcomes: Sight translate legal, business and medical documents from English into Spanish and from Spanish into English.
Consecutively interpret speech from English into Spanish and Spanish into English in legal, business, and medical settings.
Demonstrate knowledge of professional associations existing in the fields of translation and interpreting.
Demonstrate effective use of resources such as dictionaries and the internet in performing terminological research.
Demonstrate knowledge of protocol appropriate to setting in which student is interpreting.
Demonstrate knowledge of terminology appropriate to setting in which student is interpreting.
Demonstrate knowledge of appropriate entry-level positions available in the job market for interpreters.
Demonstrate knowledge of appropriate venues for further study in Translation and Interpreting.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the A.S. degree and the Certificate of Achievement. The single list of Program Requirements (18 units) is read as applying to the certificate. The A.S. adds general education and graduation requirements.
The program learning outcomes are printed once for the program as a whole. The certificate shares them, so they are recorded here.
CMI-71 (Bilingual Interpretation for the Medical Professions, 6 units) is required in the catalog but absent from the closed list. It is marked as a catalog addition.
The closed list's units for CMI 81 (6) match the catalog. The closed-list units total 12, while the catalog total is 18 because it includes CMI-71.
The heading appears three times with slightly different program codes (MAS557/C/MCE557 and MAS557/MAS557B/MAS557C/MCE557). The first form is recorded as the section heading.
